privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires a red ellipse and the red text 'URGENT' to be placed over a bright lesion in the lower right center of a grayscale DICOM image. The final output must be a JPEG file named 'urgent_finding.jpg' located in '/home/ga/DICOM/exports/'. The file size must be at least 5000 bytes to be considered a valid export.
